items.title_zh: 想测试特斯拉的全自动驾驶吗？您现在可以在 Turo 上租用它。

items.title: Waymo adds nearly 250 square miles of robotaxi coverage in 5 cities
items.title_zh: Waymo 在 5 个城市增加了近 250 平方英里的机器人出租车覆盖范围

items.title: Musk declares Tesla Robotaxi win over Waymo, but Waymo still drives 7x more
items.title_zh: 马斯克宣称 Tesla Robotaxi 战胜了 Waymo，但 Waymo 的驾驶速度仍是后者的 7 倍

items.title: Here's How Zoox's Robotaxi Safety Testing Will Work
items.title_zh: Zoox 的 Robotaxi 安全测试将如何进行

items.title: TSLA Stock Rises As Cybercabs Overtake Model Ys In Authorized Texas Robotaxi Fleet
items.title_zh: 随着网络出租车在德克萨斯州授权机器人出租车车队中超越 Ys 型，特斯拉股价上涨

items.title: Xpanner launches autonomous pile driver for solar farm contruction
items.summary: Xpanner's new X1 Piling R6 robot autonomously drives solar posts with one operator, improving placement accuracy while cutting on-site labor. The post Xpanner launches autonomous pile driver for solar farm contruction appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: Xpanner 推出用于太阳能发电场建设的自动打桩机
items.summary_zh: Xpanner 的新型 X1 打桩 R6 机器人只需一名操作员即可自动驱动太阳能柱，提高放置精度，同时减少现场劳动力。 Xpanner 推出用于太阳能发电场建设的自动打桩机的帖子首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: Bedrock Robotics nears $1B in total funding as demand for autonomous heavy equipment surges
items.summary: Bedrock Robotics has secured $600 million to scale autonomous heavy equipment and combat construction labor shortages. The post Bedrock Robotics nears $1B in total funding as demand for autonomous heavy equipment surges appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: 随着自主重型设备需求激增，Bedrock Robotics 总融资接近 10 亿美元
items.summary_zh: Bedrock Robotics 已获得 6 亿美元资金，用于扩展自主重型设备并解决建筑劳动力短缺问题。由于对自主重型设备的需求激增，Bedrock Robotics 的总资金接近 10 亿美元，该报告首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: Stalled in D.C., Waymo turns to Virginia
items.title_zh: Waymo 在华盛顿陷入停滞，转向弗吉尼亚州

items.title: 'A Weird Religious Stance:' GM Exec Says Ditching Radar For Self-Driving 'Ignores Physics'
items.title_zh: “一种奇怪的宗教立场：”通用汽车高管表示，放弃雷达而转向自动驾驶“忽视了物理原理”

items.title: Waymo is stretching out.
items.title_zh: Waymo 正在伸展身体。

items.title: Waymo nearly doubles its San Diego map, adding La Jolla and Mission Bay
items.title_zh: Waymo 的圣地亚哥地图几乎翻了一番，新增了拉荷亚 (La Jolla) 和使命湾 (Mission Bay)

items.title: ANYbotics begins delivering ANYmal X legged robot for explosive atmospheres
items.summary: ANYbotics has designed the ANYmal X inspection robot to comply with the strictest safety standards of the oil, gas, and chemical industries. The post ANYbotics begins delivering ANYmal X legged robot for explosive atmospheres appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: ANYbotics 开始提供适用于爆炸性环境的 ANYmal X 腿机器人
items.summary_zh: ANYbotics 设计的 ANYmal X 检查机器人符合石油、天然气和化工行业最严格的安全标准。 ANYbotics 开始为爆炸性环境提供 ANYmal X 腿机器人的帖子首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: Embotech and BMW move 1M vehicles with automated driving technology
items.summary: Embotech is automatically moving 3,500 vehicles around the clock daily across four BMW sites in the U.K. and Germany. The post Embotech and BMW move 1M vehicles with automated driving technology appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: Embotech 和 BMW 使用自动驾驶技术运送 100 万辆汽车
items.summary_zh: Embotech 每天全天候在英国和德国的四个 BMW 工厂自动运输 3,500 辆车辆。 Embotech 和宝马使用自动驾驶技术移动 100 万辆汽车的消息首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: OMRON to acquire OnLogic to address edge AI applications
items.summary: OMRON will add industrial computing from OnLogic to its industrial automation expertise to serve data- and AI-intensive applications. The post OMRON to acquire OnLogic to address edge AI applications appeared first on The Robot Report .
items.title_zh: 欧姆龙收购 OnLogic 以解决边缘人工智能应用问题
items.summary_zh: 欧姆龙将把 OnLogic 的工业计算添加到其工业自动化专业知识中，为数据和人工智能密集型应用提供服务。欧姆龙收购 OnLogic 以解决边缘人工智能应用的消息首先出现在《机器人报告》上。

items.title: Tesla’s New Robotaxi Problem Would Make Most Rivals Jealous
items.title_zh: 特斯拉的新机器人出租车问题将使大多数竞争对手嫉妒
